scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained after classical heat-kernel reflection. Numerical quadratures corroborate normalizations and root location but do not certify infinite-dimensional conclusions. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional half-line with ordinary Dirichlet and Neumann heat kernels, indicator multipliers and squared Hilbert-Schmidt norms only. No corresponding higher-dimensional, trace-class, or general multiplier assertion. Historical priority for reflected-Gaussian heat leakage calculations not fully excluded.
title: Gaussian-mass rigidity and a unique Neumann peak for half-line heat commutators
